تبتهجي (form VIII)
# تَبْتَهِجِي (tabtahijī) /tab.ta.hi.d͡ʒiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# تُبْتَهَجِي (tubtahajī) /tub.ta.ha.d͡ʒiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
